Union Minister Jitendra Singh has accused the Cockroach Janta Party of receiving funds from unauthorised, anti-India sources. He claims that there is evidence that CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke is receiving funds from the U.S while Co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka has been receiving funds from Pakistan
